issue: The initial Linux scoring controller had Docker SDK access but no Linux docker CLI. SWE-bench 5.0.2 cleanup_container invokes the CLI, so completed tail containers could remain after reports were written.
cross_arm_container_state: Official create_container removes any same-name existing container through Docker SDK, then creates from the configured immutable image before evaluation.
remediation: Three explicitly named completed evaluator containers were removed and their absence verified; the new controller passed actual official create/start/cleanup and Docker SDK absence verification.
environment_health_claim: Harness execution completion and zero harness report errors do not alone establish all test-framework or dependency health.
